text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
alongside Wonder Acute—

I called them out to the roundabout in 
front of the station, keeping where we 
were going and all the details a complete 
secret.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer-san. You said we were 
going on a trip, so I got all packed and 
ready, but~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What's this yellow bus? It's different 
from the one that usually takes us to the 
racetrack.
choice_data_list: This bus is headed for... the hot springs!
This bus is headed for... the hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Hot springs? Are we gonna race in a hot 
spring?"
choice_data_list:
No, let's go on that hot spring trip we 
won from the lottery.

No, let's go on the hot springs trip I won 
in the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A hot springs trip?! Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is it really alright if I take it easy and 
rest for a while?

After freezing for a brief moment, Wonder 
Acute—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... I'm so glad, truly grateful...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you made "sunrise" happen just to 
make me happy, didn't you? Thank you, 
thank you so much...

"...The sun won't rise. It's not a 
sunrise, it's a surprise. But moving 
on..."

We decided to go out together for a 
pleasant, heartwarming outing.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mnyaaaaah... Trainer... This is... sheer 
paradise~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"My whole body is just glowing with 
happiness... Ahhh, I can't get enough of 
it."

It seemed like Wonder Acute truly enjoyed 
the hot spring from the bottom of her 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"When you soak in an open-air bath... the 
warmth slowly, gently seeps in from the 
back of your knees~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I feel like I'm gonna melt~. Trainer, 
thanks for such a lovely time, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Soaking in the hot water gave me plenty of 
time to talk to her. Plenty... and plenty 
indeed.

"Did she bump into someone in the open-air 
bath? Curious, I decide to ask..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't calling out to "someone else," 
but to "every part of my own body."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Telling my hands, my legs, and my back, 
thank you for always doing your best for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you run in a lot of races, you're bound 
to get worn out, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why taking care of them is so 
important~. They're always enduring 
injuries and aches for us, after all.

The reason Wonder Acute has been able to 
keep going for so long might largely be 
thanks to how well she takes care of her 
body.

"Just as she took care of her own body, I 
wanted to cherish and support Wonder Acute 
just as much."
choice_data_list:
I want you to relax as much as possible on 
this trip.

Please relax as much as you can on this 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Is that all right, Trainer? You don't 
even want to go for a light jog?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I want to let them get some proper 
rest.
Yeah, I want them to get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Trainer, thank you... thank you so 
much...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, tomorrow I think I'll wander 
around in nature. I've always longed for 
something like that~.
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-san, check it out. 
It's a grasshopper! There's a grasshopper 
right there!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hopping along together, boing-boing. I'm 
so glad for you, Mr. Grasshopper...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The sound of this murmuring 
stream... It's so soothing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wish we could stay like this forever and 
ever. Haaah...♪

I simply watch Wonder Acute enjoying her 
relaxing recuperation with a warm smile...

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Wonder Acute...
